title: nexo.queue vs rabbitmq — work queue
hot_path: End-to-end pipeline (push → consume → ack): job-queue users measure sustained msgs/sec of the full cycle, not raw enqueue.

durability.nexo: push confirmed after commit to shared SQLite WAL (synchronous=NORMAL): crash-consistent, residual power-loss window — just below rabbit-d, above rabbit-v
durability.reference: reported in two tiers — rabbit-d: durable queue + persistent msgs + confirms + manual ack; rabbit-v: non-durable + non-persistent + no confirm + auto-ack
